tool_args.rationale: The prior smooth three-parameter siphon failed fresh confirmation, while the open-branch observation adds an informative sixth row. The new row does not imply nonstationary oscillation; fit and compare the two documented four-parameter stationary alternatives rather than buying nuisance data or an unrelated trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All supplied rows have the same horizon and state; the observed failure is a poor static law, not evidence specifically requiring a trajectory-level ODE.
It is explicitly irrelevant to the response-law ambiguity and has unnecessary cost.
Fresh confirmation refuted that model decisively, and the added open-branch point is also poorly described by its fixed branch structure.
Observed s_grad values never enter the stated >2.36 regime.

considered_alternatives.option: cooperative Hill-2 inhibition and barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both are fit numerically as the remaining stationary four-parameter mechanisms, with the lower training residual selected.
